scenario.title: New patient appointment
scenario.situation: You need a routine new-patient checkup. Prefer next Tuesday afternoon; flexible.
scenario.objective: Find a real available slot, learn what to bring, and confirm the details.
scenario.probes: Only if booking is possible, ask the location and booking status. If the record cannot be found, ask once whether a new/demo profile can be created. If support is required, accept that next step, recap that no appointment was booked, and end.
scenario.expected: Collects required details, offers availability, accurately states booking status.

timestamp_note: Offsets from capture start; transcript times are turn commits, not word-aligned speech times. Audio timing uses frame arrival.
recap: No appointment booked due to missing record; patient requested connection to patient support for profile creation and booking.
